Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished production-quality 2D environment background for ToonStudio's comic and illustration asset library, not a collage or contact sheet.
Subject: a quiet contemporary Korean residential alley on a clear early autumn morning, warm brick homes, modest stone retaining walls, utility lines carefully composed above, a few potted plants, depth leading to a bend, no people. Original setting without recognizable protected properties or brands.
Style: premium hand-painted webtoon background, accurate coherent architectural perspective, delicately inked structural edges, natural light, nuanced warm stone and cool blue ambient shadows, beautiful painterly material detail. Clear readable foreground, midground and distance. No blurry AI smearing or tangled geometry. Sophisticated harmonious color, high detail that holds up at zoom.
Composition: wide landscape 16:9, eye-level camera, usable empty foreground in the lower third for creators to place characters and editable speech bubbles. Full bleed finished background with clean corners, no border.
Output: highest available image quality and resolution; aim for 2560x1440 or higher if supported. No text, lettering, signage, logos, watermarks, UI, speech bubbles, or panel divisions.
This is a reusable professional drawing resource, not an image of a product interface.

Edit this existing background image with one precise correction: completely remove the pale white signature-like mark in the extreme lower-right corner. Continue the natural asphalt road texture seamlessly where the mark was. Preserve the entire original scene, composition, perspective, morning lighting, palette, detailed buildings, vegetation and all other pixels as faithfully as possible. Keep full original dimensions and highest quality. Do not add text, signatures, logos or watermarks anywhere.
